story:
Firefly Contractors ＆ Design is a locally owned, family-run remodeling company based in Spokane Valley, Washington, on a mission to revolutionize residential construction by putting people first and delivering excellence on every project. Now a little over two years in business, our team protects and reinvents Spokane-area homes — full roof replacements, new siding, windows, decks, and insulation — with a licensed, insured, and bonded team that treats your home like our own.

Our championship mindset shapes every decision: straight talk, clean job sites, and craftsmanship you can point at years later. Whether you need storm-damaged shingles replaced or you're ready to add the deck you have been picturing, Firefly leads with thoughtful design, skilled trades, and a commitment to continuous improvement — all backed by a written workmanship warranty and a name your neighbors know.
